summary: This Form 8-K filed by American Healthcare REIT, Inc. reports the exercise in full of the underwriter's option to purchase 2,100,000 additional shares in connection with a May 22, 2026 public offering. An additional forward sale agreement was entered into with an affiliate of BofA Securities, with shares borrowed and sold to hedge the forward purchaser's obligations. Proceeds are expected to be contributed to the operating partnership for general corporate purposes, including potential investments. The filing is a routine follow-up to a capital markets transaction, not a special situation event. No board recommendation or advisor is cited. The forward settlement may occur through May 2028. No deal terms or special-situations classification apply.
